method: Two immutable images; prior fast engine versus candidate fast engine; alternating AB/BA pairs; fresh containers and output directories; no discarded samples; caches not flushed

timing_scope.container_seconds: Docker FinishedAt minus StartedAt; includes startup and exit, excludes Docker create/client/inspection/removal. Daemon wall-clock timestamps; not the portal timer.
timing_scope.wall_seconds: Host monotonic timer around output setup, Docker create/start/inspect/remove, permission cleanup, and scratch deletion; excludes output comparison.

notes: Generated-data CI comparison, not a hidden-data portal score. The supplied baseline image is identified by its immutable ID and declared source commit. Both images are required to finish on the fast path. CPU quota and cpuset stay fixed even when NCPU overrides vary worker counts. Peak RSS is not measured.
